description: This file defines the BroadcastChannelProviderBuilder class which implements configuration for broadcast channel providers in Orleans, supporting both silo and client builders. It includes assembly attributes for provider registration.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class that configures broadcast channel providers for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to add a broadcast channel with specified options.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to add a broadcast channel with specified options.
